objects.name: Analytic 2148
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an account on an ICS Linux host invoking SSH, SNMP, or another remote-management utility with a non-local target to query remote system identity, hardware, operating-system, or inventory information outside the approved management baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; SSH/SNMP/remote-management command includes a remote target host and queries system identity/inventory from an account outside the authorized management set
